_meta.title: Measurement configuration — outbound clicks and page events
_meta.note: This file is the single source for assets/measure-config.js and measurement/index.html (tools/build_measurement.py). Counting stays OFF while endpoint_url is empty. The five events below are PROPOSED by this build: the brief names five events but does not list them (flag M38-F-04).

endpoint_status: Not configured. GitHub Pages serves static files and cannot receive POST requests, so no collector is hosted for this site. The owner must host tools/analytics_endpoint.py on a host of their choice and set endpoint_url here.
event_definitions_status: Proposed by build 38650305. The brief asks for 'the five defined events' but does not name them. Owner confirmation required (DEC-03 in data/shop/decisions.json).

events.name: page_view
events.sends: event name, page path (no query string, no hash), UTC day, protocol version.
events.does_not_send: visitor ID, IP address, user agent, referrer, cookies, screen or device data.

events.name: outbound_click
events.when: A click on any link marked rel="sponsored" (every link to amazon.com or link.amazon).
events.sends: event name, page path, link host, and the link's last path segment when it is a 4 to 20 character letter-or-digit code (the short-link token or ASIN as written in the link).
events.does_not_send: the destination's query string, any tag value beyond what is in the path, or anything that identifies a person.

events.name: guide_view
events.when: Load of a guide page: /guides/<name>.html or /site/guides/<name>.html, excluding the index pages.
events.sends: event name, page path, UTC day.

events.name: intent_view
events.when: Load of the product-intent confirmation record (/intent-record/).
events.sends: event name, page path, UTC day.

events.name: flag_view
events.when: Load of the flagged-for-review page or the publication pass page.
events.sends: event name, page path, UTC day.

browser_rules: No cookies, localStorage or sessionStorage are written by the counter.
No visitor identifier is generated or sent.
If navigator.globalPrivacyControl is true, or Do Not Track is '1', nothing is sent.
If endpoint_url is empty or enabled is false, nothing is sent and no network request is made.
Sends use navigator.sendBeacon with a text/plain body, so the browser does not read any response.
collector_rules: Accepts only the five event names above; anything else returns 400.
Stores daily totals per event, page path and link token. It does not store IP addresses, user agents, referrers or request logs.
The server clock sets the day. Client-supplied dates are ignored.
Read access to totals requires a token set in the environment (Z3_ANALYTICS_READ_TOKEN). Without it, the read endpoint is disabled.
